tasks.short: Demonstrate games and procedures to new dealers, watch them deal and correct them, drill them on payouts and house rules, and record their progress.

steps.what: Casino dealer demonstrates games and table procedures to train new dealers
Casino dealer watches trainees deal and corrects them
Casino dealer quizzes trainees on payouts and house rules
Casino dealer records trainee progress on a paper checklist

tasks.design: Trainees practise payouts and house rules on a drill app ({LMS}) with a fixed question bank that code scores, so the dealer quizzes only the weak points. Progress is ticked on a skills checklist per trainee in the same system instead of on paper. Demonstrating games and correcting trainees at the table stay with the dealer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Payouts were drilled by hand and progress kept on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Learning systems run scored drills and skills checklists.
tasks.still_hard: Speed and hand skills come only from dealing.
tasks.human_edge: Showing a trainee how to stay calm with an angry player.

reach.task: Approve new dealers for live tables

evidence.claim: Learning systems can run scored drills and skills checklists.
Casinos must train staff to recognise addiction and record signs of excessive play.

assumptions: Boundary: from the new dealer to progress recorded; the live-table approval is outside.
Input contract: question bank kept by the training department; fallback is quizzing by hand.
Demonstrating and correcting do not change.
Trainees drill during training hours; no added time.
research_questions: Do payout errors in the first month fall?

incremental.description: Casino dealer reviews trainees' drill scores.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: one trainee at a time; high: large intake classes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Count the chip float at table close, write the counts on a count sheet, total and reconcile against the drop, explain variances, check the collection report, and send it to the supervisor.

steps.what: Casino dealer counts the chip float at table close
Casino dealer writes the counts on the paper count sheet
Casino dealer totals the counts and checks them against the drop and float in a spreadsheet
Casino dealer checks the final collection report
Casino dealer e-mails collection reports for submission to supervisors

tasks.design: The dealer enters chip counts per denomination on a count form at the table ({OPS_SYSTEM}) instead of a paper sheet. Code totals them, checks them against the recorded drop and the opening float, and flags any variance. The dealer explains variances and checks the report; once checked, it goes to the supervisor from the form. Counting chips and explaining variances stay with the dealer. No model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counts were written on paper and tallied in spreadsheets mailed to supervisors.
tasks.enabler_now: Count forms with fixed reconciliation rules run on table tablets.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong count typed in is still wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Remembering the fill that explains a variance.
tasks.altitude: The dealer explains variances instead of adding up columns.

reach.learn: Whether reports arrive complete and reconciled.

evidence.claim: Count forms with fixed reconciliation rules can total counts and flag variances.
The Ksa supervises anti money laundering rules for gambling operators.

assumptions: Boundary: from the table close to the report submitted; the cage count is outside.
Input contract: drop and float recorded by the cage; fallback is paper sheets.
Variances are shown per table, not used to rate dealers, without works council consent.

incremental.description: Casino dealer corrects count entries the form rejects.

approvals.approved_version: The report as checked by the dealer in s5.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few tables with many variances; high: many tables closing cleanly.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The casino dealer keeps training at the table, counting chips and explaining variances; paper checklists, count sheets and spreadsheet tallies shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A dealer with more time at the table.
